item.title: Qarabagh shopkeepers demand rollback of steep rent hikes
item.description: A number of shopkeepers in the market of Qarabagh district in the capital Kabul have complained about rising shop rents and urged the authorities to reduce them.

item.title: 37 killed, 25 hospitalised after gas inhalation in Nigeria
item.description: At least 37 miners have died and 25 others were hospitalised due to suffocation at a mining site in Plateau State, Nigeria, media reports said.

item.title: US to withdraw 1,000 troops from Syria after almost 10 years
item.description: The United States plans to withdraw around 1,000 remaining troops from Syria over the next two months, a media report said on Thursday.

item.title: Afghanistan set to face Canada in T20 WC match today
item.description: Afghanistan are set to face Canada in their final group-stage match of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup today (Thursday) at the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai.

item.title: Sweden pledges 70m kr to IOM to support migrant returns
item.description: The Swedish government has announced a contribution of SEK 70 million to the International Organization for Migration (IOM) to accelerate the return of migrants to Afghanistan, Syria and Somalia.

item.title: Brazilian football player Kathleen Souza converts to Islam
item.description: A 29-year-old Brazilian footballer Kathleen Souza, who plays for Saudi Arabian team Al-Nassr, has converted to Islam.

item.title: 10 killed, 14 injured in Karachi gas cylinder blast
item.description: At least 10 people have been killed and 14 others injured after a gas cylinder exploded in the Soldier Bazaar area of Karachi, Pakistan.

item.title: 214 Afghans freed from Pakistani prisons return home
item.description: The Ministry of Refugees and Repatriation (MoRR) announced on Thursday that 214 Afghan migrants, recently released from prisons in Pakistan, have returned to Afghanistan.
